title: Rav Acha bar Pinchas
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Moed Katan 15a](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.15a.13) he spoke in the name of Rav Yosef. Hyman cites 13b for the attribution to Rav Huna son of Rav Pinchas. He is also mentioned in [Eruvin 29b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.29b.11).[^1]

notes.text: In the parallel passage at [Moed Katan 15b](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.15b.14), Rav Huna son of Rav Pinchas likewise reports in Rav Yosef’s name. The two passages apply a similar argument to different restrictions. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=335&lang=en) identifies the 15a speaker as Rav Acha bar Pinchas.
